title: Speaker of the Assembly
selection: Elected by the Assembly at the start of every term (Week 1).
tenure: One term.

holders.note: Election scheduled for Week 1 — Formation. While serving, the Speaker transfers control of their bloc to the party floor leader.

title: Deputy Speakers (party-proportional)
selection: Drawn from the parties in proportion to their seats when the Bureau is formed.
tenure: One term.
